note: Adapted from 'Fauna Sinica, Insecta, the seventeenth volume, Isoptera'; the original is in Chinese. The original combination is Coptotermes (P.) ochraceus Ping et Xu, 1986 (Scientia Silvae Sinicae 22(2): 156—157), given in the book as comb. nov., and Coptotermes (P.) zhenyuanensis He et Qiu, 1990 is listed as a new synonym. For the length of the left mandible the original gives two sets of values, '0.99—1.04(1.05)' and a mean of 1.02, both transcribed. The original describes the soldier only.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head ochraceous yellow, mandibles purplish brown, pronotum, abdomen and legs pale yellow, tarsi yellow. Head sparsely hairy, fontanelle hairs 2 pairs, long hairs in the middle area of the pronotum fewer than 10. Head oval, posterior margin of the head rather straight, fontanelle triangular, the opening rather oblique in lateral view, the dorsal margin of the head sloping towards the posterior margin, the highest point slightly behind the top of the fontanelle; antennae 16-segmented; labrum acutely triangular; mandibles sabre-shaped, the tips rather curved, the length of the left mandible about 0.57—0.63 times the head capsule length; the broad area of the postmentum at about the anterior 1/3, the centre of the broad area appearing as a dot-like projection, with a few transverse striae before and behind it, narrowing from the broad area backwards into a waist, the waist at the posterior 1/3, the sides of the waist region forming a broad arc, the postmentum length about 4 times the waist width. Pronotum flat, anterior and posterior margins shallowly concave at the middle, width about 1.8 times the midlength; metanotum about as wide as the pronotum; hind tibia length about 0.89—0.99 times the maximum head width. Measurements (range/mean): head length to the mandible base (1.63) 1.66—1.80 (1.74) mm, maximum head width 1.28—1.43 (1.35) mm, head width at the mandible base 0.74—0.80 (0.78) mm, head height 1.00—1.07 (1.03) mm, left mandible length 0.99—1.04 (1.05) (1.02) mm, postmentum length 1.05—1.17 (1.10) mm, postmentum width 0.43—0.47 (0.44) mm, postmentum waist 0.25—0.29 (0.27) mm, pronotum length 0.56—0.64 (0.59) mm, pronotum midlength 0.50—0.56 (0.52) mm, pronotum width 0.90—1.02 (0.95) mm, hind tibia length 1.22—1.30 (1.25) mm. Host: peach tree; distribution Guizhou (Xingyi, Zhenyuan).
